def has_required_scope(conn: HTTPConnection, scopes: typing.Sequence[str]
    ) ->bool:
    if not hasattr(conn, 'auth') or conn.auth is None:
        return False
    
    if isinstance(conn.auth, AuthCredentials):
        existing_scopes = set(conn.auth.scopes)
        required_scopes = set(scopes)
        return required_scopes.issubset(existing_scopes)
    
    return False
